def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create a channel with capacity cap, try to send each element of xs without blocking, and return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= xs.len()
    post out <= cap
    tx, rx = Channel[int](cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        tx.try_send(x) else return n
        n += 1
    return n

    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= xs.len()

        n += 1
    return n
